# Results

Phase results (JSON files) are generated by running analyses via the CLI and are not committed to the repository due to size (~113 MB, 500+ files).

## Regenerating results

```bash
uv run voynich <phase-command>
```

For example:

```bash
uv run voynich phase14    # Phase 14: Sub-Cell Feature Model
uv run voynich phase16    # Phase 16: Modifier Detection
uv run voynich phase15    # Phase 15: Feature Refinement
```

Run `uv run voynich --help` for the full list of available commands.

See [docs/phases/](../docs/phases/) for expected outputs and key metrics for each phase.
